verdict_note: Engine, gates, bridge, and executor are solid (771 admissible tests passing, all diagnostic suites green, ingest verified side-effect-free). The blank-prompt product experience is blocked by first-run gating, information architecture, and Slither-default gaps. All P0s are ordering/guarding/copy fixes, not engine changes.

diagnostics.git_status: clean before audit; audit adds tests/test_admissible_first_run_product_gaps.py and two report files; nothing committed

gaps.observed_behavior: generate_next_instruction_packet() and the bridge's write_next_instruction_with_controller() succeed on a blank session: the packet TASK is 'No goal has been submitted to Admissible yet.', the run-loop turn advances, the instruction file is written into the workspace, and bridge-state.json sets awaiting_response=true (probes P1/P2).
gaps.expected_behavior: Both paths raise a clear 'submit a goal first' ValueError; the UI disables 'Write instruction file' and 'Generate next agent instruction' with an inline reason; the turn counter is untouched and no file is written.
gaps.suggested_fix: Guard in ControlSurfaceController.generate_next_instruction_packet when self._session.goal_intake is None; delete the 'No goal has been submitted' fallback from run_loop.generate_instruction_packet; expose has_goal in state_view and disable the buttons client-side with a reason.

gaps.observed_behavior: Blank session renders Session Diagnostics first, then the Cursor bridge (all buttons enabled), Mission Summary, Supervised Run State, queue, and Selected Action; the goal form is the 10th panel, below the fold. The empty state says 'Send a goal below' while the visible controls point elsewhere.
gaps.expected_behavior: Blank session leads with a large focused goal input; bridge/workspace/instruction controls are hidden or disabled-with-reason until a goal exists; a stepper shows the run phases.
gaps.suggested_fix: Reorder panels goal-first; add has_goal, run_phase, next_expected_action to state_view; render a single current-step line driving which controls are active.

gaps.observed_behavior: 'Load sample Slither session' is the only primary-styled header button; the goal placeholder and empty state also name Slither; load_sample_session() silently replaces an in-progress session with no confirmation (probe P5) while the less destructive Reset button does confirm.
gaps.expected_behavior: Sample demoted to a secondary 'Load a sample run' affordance in a sample gallery/advanced drawer; generic goal placeholder; confirmation or auto-archive before replacing a non-empty session; sample sessions labeled is_sample_session.
gaps.suggested_fix: Rename/demote the button, move it into the advanced drawer, require confirm (or refuse) when goal_intake or queue is non-empty, mark resulting sessions as samples.
suggested_tests: new: load_sample_session refuses/archives when session non-empty

gaps.observed_behavior: Instruction turns that never receive a response (e.g. the no-goal turn 1) stay in bridge_awaiting_turns forever; session diagnostics permanently show 'Yes — turn(s) 1 awaiting Cursor response' even after later turns complete round trips (probe P3).
gaps.expected_behavior: Writing a new instruction supersedes the previous outstanding turn; superseded turns are excluded from the awaiting list; diagnostics reflect only the genuinely outstanding turn.
gaps.suggested_fix: Track a superseded_by_turn field on RunTurn (or compute: only the latest packet turn can be awaiting) and report at most one awaiting turn.
suggested_tests: new: after write(no-response) + write + ingest, bridge_awaiting_turns == []

gaps.observed_behavior: After 'Reset local session', a response file written for the pre-reset instruction ingests cleanly into the fresh session: bridge-state.json stores session_id but _validate_response_for_ingest never compares it, and session_turn=0 is falsy so the turn-mismatch guard is skipped (probe P6).
gaps.expected_behavior: Ingest rejects a response whose bridge-state session_id does not match the live session; turn 0 is handled explicitly ('no instruction written by this session yet').
gaps.suggested_fix: Add session-id comparison and explicit session_turn==0 rejection with a typed error and recorded blocked-ingest transcript entry.
suggested_tests: new: write under session A, reset to session B, ingest -> CursorBridgeError(reason=session_mismatch)

gaps.observed_behavior: Manual paste ingest (ingest_agent_response) accepts a response with no goal and no instruction; a queue item is created at turn 0 (probe P4).
gaps.expected_behavior: Manual paste path requires a goal (or is explicitly labeled and gated as a debug-only import) so a blank session cannot acquire queue items with no run objective.
gaps.suggested_fix: Same has_goal guard as GAP-001, with a debug override flag if the raw-import capability must remain for lab use.
suggested_tests: new: ingest_agent_response without goal raises unless debug flag set

gaps.observed_behavior: Debug-grade material is visible by default: session diagnostics (file path, disk-load flag, turn bookkeeping), bridge file facts (sha256/bytes/mtime), raw packet textarea, full autonomy fine print, triple-repeated non-execution banners, 15-tile mission summary including 'side_effect_executed_by_admissible: false'.
gaps.expected_behavior: Default view shows only: goal/run overview, current step, agent handoff status, decisions needed, admitted actions, execution evidence. Everything else in one collapsed Advanced/Debug drawer; one calm persistent safety line.
gaps.suggested_fix: Implement the 7-level hierarchy from the audit report section 6; move diagnostics/transcript/decision-history/raw-preview into the drawer.

gaps.observed_behavior: Lab phrasing: 'Admissible Control Surface v0', 'Mission Summary', 'Supervised Run State', 'Admissible Action Admission Queue', 'Cursor supervised file bridge', 'Ingest Cursor response file', 'Attest executed after admission'; safety boundary repeated in 3 warning banners plus footer plus packet text.
gaps.expected_behavior: Product-grade names (Run overview, Decisions needed, Proposed actions, Agent handoff, Send instructions to agent, Check for agent response, Apply approved file changes, Mark as done outside Admissible); one persistent calm safety line with full boundary text in the drawer.
gaps.suggested_fix: Apply the copy table in audit report section 8.
suggested_tests: HTML copy guards asserting new names and single always-visible safety banner

gaps.observed_behavior: Mission summary renders 15 stat tiles including zero-value tiles and a raw boolean sentence about side effects.
gaps.expected_behavior: 3-4 headline tiles (needs you now, admitted, executed, blocked); remaining counts live in the actions view or drawer.
gaps.suggested_fix: Reduce headline tiles; keep full counts in state_view for the drawer.

gaps.observed_behavior: control_surface.html is a 1,617-line monolith (CSS + markup + ~1,150 lines JS); render(state) re-renders 12 panels per action; UI derives product state (button enablement) client-side.
gaps.expected_behavior: Same stdlib no-build server, but split static assets (css/js modules/template) served by the handler; server-provided run_phase/blocked_reason fields drive the UI.
gaps.suggested_fix: Split files without introducing a framework or build step; add missing state_view fields (has_goal, run_phase, next_expected_action, blocked_reason, is_sample_session).
suggested_tests: existing HTML-content tests updated to read the split assets; live rehearsal test unchanged

verified_ok: Ingest creates no files outside .admissible/ (probe P7 + new guard test)
Bounded execution requires admission for all non-ALLOW decisions (new guard test)
Rules-only decisions never mutated by human decisions, evidence, or execution
Stale/duplicate bridge responses blocked with typed errors and transcript records
Goal intake is task-agnostic; non-Slither dynamic run proven by tiny-local-game suite
Corrupt session files fail loudly instead of silently resetting
